summary.headline: Planetary Epochs and Fixed Stars
summary.text: Discussion of epochs, centers, and lots of the seven planets, giving their positions and detailed relationships to fixed stars. The Sun in Scorpio and Moon in Taurus are analyzed by longitude, latitude, planetary houses, bounds, triplicities, decans, exaltations, depressions, faces, and monomoiria, with references to Ptolemy and Egyptian doctrine.
